releaseNotes: feat: Add panel management functionality with rate limiting and user agent classification
changelog: Introduced `PcPanelAdder` for handling panel addition with validation and diagnostics.
Implemented `PcSessionAttemptLimiter` to limit connection attempts per session.
Enhanced user agent classification in `PcSessionStore` to identify device OS and type.
Updated API routes in `PcApiRouter` to support adding and testing panels.
Added new data models for panel requests and responses.
Integrated skeleton loading UI in the frontend with `skeleton.js`.
Improved session information DTO to include device details.
Added comprehensive unit tests for panel addition and session attempt limiting.
